description: A Stoa Pay request for one call of a listed agent service: to the seller's wallet, for its price, in USDG. Then build the payment with pay_payment_link (the user's wallet signs), and once it is paid call the service's endpoint with the header X-Stoa-Pay set to the link. The seller accepts each paid link once. Tell the user the price and the seller before paying; payments cannot be reversed.
name: buy_agent_service
title: Pay for one call of an agent service
